text:
0




Public Teaser Review

Filter the noise before you even sign the NDA. Searchers review hundreds of proprietary teasers and lower-middle-market listings. To help you source the right deals, I provide a free, specialized assessment tool to analyze a teaser’s basic metrics (industry, headcount, revenue) and instantly score its automation potential.

Best for: Top-of-funnel deal sourcing and filtering.
Deliverable: An instant “Automation Potential Score” to tell you if the industry and operational profile are ripe for margin expansion.
Investment: Free.


Get the Free AI prompt to assess automation potential.

Copy and paste this prompt into your preferred AI (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok, or whatever) and get a preliminary AI-based analysis of the automation potential of the listing.






1




Post-NDA

Discover hidden value before you submit an offer. Once you sign the NDA and receive the Confidential Information Memorandum (CIM), you need to know quickly if the target has low-hanging operational fruit. I review the target’s financial and operational profile to identify where automation can replace manual bottlenecks and increase capacity without adding headcount.

Best for: Validating your investment thesis before submitting an LOI.
Deliverable: A concise AI Upside Memo estimating potential operational savings, revenue capacity increases, and a preliminary assessment of workforce adaptability.
Investment: Currently offering pilot pricing for new search fund partners.

Discuss the Tech of an Active Acquisition




2




Post-LOI

De-risk the technology stack during exclusivity. Once under LOI, you have a limited window to find the skeletons in the IT closet. I go under the hood of the target company to evaluate their current systems, data silos, technical debt, and readiness for modern AI integration, ensuring the team is actually equipped to handle a digital transition.

Best for: The 60-90 day due diligence window.
Deliverable: A comprehensive Technical DD Report highlighting security risks, immediate upgrade costs, and a clear path to technological integration.
Investment: Fixed fee based on company size and tech footprint.

Discuss the Tech of an Active Acquisition




3




Pre- or Post-Close

A concrete blueprint to secure investor buy-in or hit the ground running. Whether you need a finalized CapEx budget to present to your investors before closing, or you just got the keys and need to know where to start, I architect the exact technical strategy required to modernize the company. We determine what off-the-shelf SaaS to buy, what automations to build, and how to roll these changes out to the staff to ensure high adoption rates.

Best for: Finalizing investor memos pre-close, or strategic alignment immediately post-close.
Deliverable: A prioritized, step-by-step Implementation Roadmap including required CapEx, OPEX, and projected ROI.
Investment: Flat project fee.

Discuss the Tech of an Active Acquisition




4




Post-Close Execution

Execution from a 20-year software engineering veteran. I don’t just advise; I build. Whether integrating modern Field Service Management (FSM) systems, building custom API workflows, or deploying Holobrain—my scalable, air-gapped private AI stack for companies with strict data privacy needs—I execute the roadmap to realize the EBITDA gains we projected. I handle the technical heavy lifting while ensuring the frontline workers are comfortable and confident with the new systems.

Best for: Long-term value creation and operational scaling.
Deliverable: Working, deployed systems and comprehensive team training.
Investment: Fractional CTO retainer or milestone-based project fee.

Discuss the Tech of an Active Acquisition

text:
Why Me?

20+ Years of Experience: I have spent two decades building large-scale backends and enterprise data processing solutions. I know what it takes to make software actually work in the real world.
Business-First Mindset: I don’t build tech for tech’s sake. Every line of code or software subscription must tie back to operational efficiency and enterprise value.
Human-Centric AI Augmentation: The biggest risk in modernization is employee resistance. I architect AI automations specifically to enhance human capabilities, not replace them.

title: Pablo Baretto
text: I help companies to plan practical AI initiatives, design production-grade architectures, evaluate AI systems with real data and accelerate their AI engineering efforts.

title: Pablo Baretto
text:
Request a Consultation

Experience

2021 – Present: AI Architecture and Development Consultant (Freelance)
I engage in long-term consulting commitments (up to 2 years) with mid-market companies and venture-backed startups, designing system architectures and leading development of core AI-driven functionalities. Projects focus on building production-grade, high-accuracy AI systems in regulated or data-intensive domains.
Healthcare Startup (USA)
AI-powered compliance platform that analyzes mental-health provider reports to ensure insurance compliance.

Problem: Insurance payers reject claims at high rates due to imprecise or non-compliant language, causing revenue loss and administrative burden.

Solution: Architected and developed the core generative AI compliance engine. Implemented a data-driven AI evaluation framework + human-in-the-loop error analysis to overcome LLM hallucinations and biases.

Results: Achieved sustained 98% accuracy. Only ~2 reports per day now require human review, drastically reducing manual effort while minimizing claim denial risks.

Legal SaaS Startup (Spain)
Agentic RAG-based AI chatbot SaaS that answers legal questions for users in Ecuador, grounded in current national laws (owned by a prominent law firm).

Problem: Manual legal research was time-intensive and error-prone; keeping the knowledge base updated was slow and risked hallucinations or SLA penalties.

Solution: Built an automated real-time data processing pipeline for laws + developed an agentic RAG application with precise citations and rigorous AI evaluation frameworks.

Results: Reached 99% response accuracy, reduced human review to 1% of cases, and cut time spent answering client questions by ~90%.

Matchbook AI (USA)
SaaS master data management platform integrating and unifying company/asset data for S&P 500 clients.

Problem: Fragmented, inconsistent records across sources led to poor insights, duplicates, and SLA breaches. Legacy Elasticsearch matching required heavy manual intervention.

Solution: Designed and led development of a new ML/AI-based matching engine + full automation of the legacy Elasticsearch system.

Results: Handles ~500 million initial records + ~1 million daily updates (15% above targets) and powers the core platform for ~50 S&P 500 clients. Legacy automation eliminated all manual processes, cut processing time by 35%, and reduced SLA breaches to zero.

Sonarplatform.io (EU)
SaaS platform for blockchain transaction analytics and AI-driven trading insights.

Problem: Indexing billions of transactions with low-latency queries was technically challenging and resource-intensive.

Solution: Architected and led development of the core blockchain data platform (scalable ingestion, indexing, and query layers).

Results: Indexes ~1 billion transaction records across 10+ Ethereum networks, handles ~3,000 tx/s in real time, and delivers API responses in <800 ms (p95).

AI driven Startup (USA)
SaaS platform for personalized AI chatbots/companions using users’ own data.

Problem: Low-latency, high-accuracy search over large personal data volumes was difficult with traditional indexing.

Solution: Architected the personal information search subsystem (high-throughput indexing pipeline + hybrid lexical + vector search backend).

Results: Processes up to 200 MB/s for thousands of users; search delivers highly accurate results in <500 ms.



2015 – 2021: Logicalis (Spain)
IT services and consulting firm (part of the global Logicalis Group) focused on AI, data analytics, cloud, and digital transformation. Progressed from Cloud Solutions Architect to Data Analytics Solutions Architect.
Key Projects (Telecom & Enterprise Clients): - Orange: Architected and led development of a unified log and metrics processing platform (Elasticsearch-inspired stack).
Results: Reduced MTTD by ~55%, MTTR by 45%, unplanned downtime by 30–40%, and manual log analysis effort by >60%. - Delivered multiple production implementations and PoCs for Vodafone, Telefónica, FNMT, Grupo Piñero, La Caixa, Ocaso, AENA, and Catalana Occidente, enabling centralized observability and faster digital operations.


2006 – 2015: Senior Data Analytics Consultant
Focused on analytics for IT monitoring and support systems.

FacilDesk (Founder): Open-source IT monitoring (Elasticsearch) + ticketing (OTRS) with analytics for Latin American mid-sized firms.
Notable clients: Mitsubishi Motor Company (+67% customer satisfaction), Agroamerica, Cerámicas Caribe, Bancaribe (43% faster incident response).
Sun Microsystems Contractor (Venezuela): Data-centric monitoring for telcos (CANTV, Movilnet, Telefónica) and oil & gas (PDVSA, ENI).



2001 – 2006: Sun Microsystems (Venezuela)
Java trainer and consulting in northern Latin America.




Certifications

Google Cloud Professional Data Engineer (2020)
Elasticsearch Certified Engineer (2020)



Education

Systems Engineer, Universidad de Los Andes (Venezuela), 2001
Master’s in Marketing Management, Universidad Complutense de Madrid (Spain)

section: 1. Enterprise-Grade AI & Tech for “Boring” Business M&A
text:
1. Enterprise-Grade AI & Tech for “Boring” Business M&A
I partner with small private equity teams and search funds to assess, plan, and deploy technology in legacy acquisitions. Traditional businesses often have massive potential for margin expansion through automation, but they are also full of hidden technical debt.
I help buyers navigate the entire M&A lifecycle by:

Identifying the operational bottlenecks where automation will drive immediate, concrete EBITDA wins.
Hunting for the hidden signals—like undocumented legacy systems or fractured data—that could ruin automation budgets.
Executing the Day-100 roadmaps as a veteran builder, ensuring the new systems are actually adopted by frontline workers.

Explore my M&A Advisory & Implementation Services

text:
2. Private, Air-Gapped AI
For organizations that need the operational power of Large Language Models (LLMs) but have strict data privacy needs, I built Holobrain.
It is a scalable, completely private AI stack. I help companies deploy open-weights models and automated workflows entirely within their own infrastructure, ensuring that proprietary company data never leaks to public APIs.
Learn more about secure AI deployments at Holobrain.ai
